texts.Blueprint:SectionNote: A rule aimed at a part draws from the shared bank for it: "ten hard listening questions", chosen afresh at every sitting. A bank question belongs to every exam at its level and so cannot be filed inside one part — but its topic, difficulty and type are facts about it that hold in every exam, and that is what a part draws on. Questions filed into a part by hand come first; the bank is what a part falls back to when it holds none.
texts.Blueprint:CannotFill: {0} rules cannot be filled. Those papers will simply come out shorter — nothing will fail, and nobody will be told.
texts.Blueprint:Explain: Without this, every candidate gets a random handful of whatever is in the bank and two scores mean nothing side by side. With it, "six grammar, four listening, two of them hard" holds for everybody however the individual questions differ — which is the whole reason to draw a paper rather than fix one.
texts.Blueprint:Lede: How many questions of what kind each drawn paper contains.
texts.Blueprint:NoneYetNote: Every paper is drawn at random from the whole bank. That is right for practice. For anything whose scores get compared, add a rule or two and every candidate gets the same balance of material.
texts.Blueprint:Title: Paper shape

texts.Exam:List:Lede: Every exam here is a draft until you publish it. Only publishing makes it sendable.

texts.Exam:Mode:Practice:Hint: Learning. The answer and explanation appear after submission, and it can be retaken.
texts.Exam:NoMatchesNote: Try another word, or clear the filter.
texts.Exam:NoneYetNote: Start with one. Questions can be added after you create it.
texts.Exam:OneAtATime:Hint: The whole paper never reaches the browser, so it cannot be dumped however many tools are opened.
texts.Exam:PassMark:Hint: A percentage, not an absolute mark — forms differ in length, so a fixed number would mean something different on every paper.
texts.Exam:Publish:Ready: Ready to publish. After this it can be sent to candidates.
texts.Exam:QuestionsPerForm:Hint: Leave empty and everyone gets the whole bank. Set it below the question count and each candidate gets a different form.
texts.Exam:ShuffleOptions:Hint: Stops "the answer is B" travelling between two people sitting together.
texts.Exam:ShuffleQuestions:Hint: A different order per attempt, stable across a reload. Questions sharing one stimulus stay together.

texts.Form:Generate:Hint: Filling from the blueprint gives you a paper to adjust rather than an empty list to build. Nothing is sent until you publish.

texts.Form:Name: Name
texts.Form:NoneYetNote: Without one, every candidate gets their own draw from the bank — right for practice, wrong for anything whose scores get compared. Create Form 1 and Form 2, and a retake is genuinely a different paper.
texts.Form:PaperEmpty: Nothing on it yet. Fill it from the blueprint, or tick questions on the right.

texts.Group:Name: Name

texts.IMS:Assignment:ExpiryInPast: The expiry date must be in the future.
texts.IMS:Assignment:FormNotAvailable: That paper is not available for this exam. It may belong to another exam, to another organisation, or it may have been deleted.
texts.IMS:Assignment:FormNotPublished: A paper has to be published before it can be sent. A draft has not been reviewed, and a retired one was taken out of rotation on purpose.
texts.IMS:Assignment:GroupEmpty: That group has nobody in it.
texts.IMS:Assignment:TargetAmbiguous: Choose a person or a group, not both.
texts.IMS:Assignment:TargetMissing: Choose a person or a group.
texts.IMS:Attempt:AwaitingReview: Your result is with a reviewer and will appear once marking is complete.
texts.IMS:Attempt:Expired: Time has run out on this attempt.
texts.IMS:Attempt:GradedCannotDelete: This attempt has been marked, so it is somebody's result. Removing it would be a disappearance rather than a correction — and the person who sat it would have no way to know. End a running attempt instead; that is recorded.
texts.IMS:Attempt:NotFound: That attempt could not be found.
texts.IMS:Attempt:NotSubmitted: This attempt has not been submitted yet.
texts.IMS:Attempt:QuestionNotOnForm: That question is not on your paper.
texts.IMS:Candidate:EmailAlreadyExists: That email address is already registered.
texts.IMS:Candidate:EmailTaken: Another candidate already uses that email address. It is how their link reaches them, so it has to belong to one person.
texts.IMS:Candidate:HasAttempts: This person has sat an exam. Their result refers to them, so they cannot be deleted.
texts.IMS:Catalog:CategoryInUse: Exams or questions are filed under this. Deactivate it instead — it disappears from the pickers and everything already filed keeps working.
texts.IMS:Catalog:CodeAlreadyExists: That code is already in use.
texts.IMS:Catalog:LevelInUse: Exams or questions are set to this level. Deactivate it instead.
texts.IMS:Catalog:TopicCycle: A topic cannot sit inside itself.
texts.IMS:Catalog:TopicInBlueprint: A blueprint rule or an exam section still uses this topic. Removing it would leave that rule drawing nothing, and every paper it shapes would quietly come out short.
texts.IMS:Catalog:TopicInUse: Questions are filed under this topic. Deactivate it instead.
texts.IMS:Exam:BankHasOverExposedItems: Some questions have been served to a great many candidates and have probably circulated.
texts.IMS:Exam:BankTooSmallToRotate: The bank is barely larger than the form, so two candidates will sit almost the same paper. Aim for about three times the form length.
texts.IMS:Exam:BlueprintUnsatisfiable: There are not enough questions to satisfy the form blueprint.
texts.IMS:Exam:BlueprintSectionNotInExam: This rule points at a part of another exam. Choose a part of this exam, or leave it to fill the whole paper.
texts.IMS:Exam:EveryoneGetsTheSameForm: Every candidate sits the same paper, so one leak is everybody’s paper.
texts.IMS:Exam:FormLargerThanBank: The form asks for more questions than the bank holds.
texts.IMS:Exam:NoQuestions: An exam cannot be published without questions.
texts.IMS:Exam:NoTopicsAssigned: No competencies assigned, so the result will be a bare number with no breakdown.
texts.IMS:Exam:NotPublished: This exam has not been published yet.
texts.IMS:Exam:OutsideSchedule: This exam is not available at this time.
texts.IMS:Exam:PracticeWithoutExplanations: Practice mode without explanations reveals the answer without teaching anything.
texts.IMS:Exam:ScheduleEndsBeforeItStarts: The end must come after the start.
texts.IMS:Exam:ScheduleNeedsBothDates: A schedule needs both a start and an end.
texts.IMS:ExamForm:AlreadyUsed: Somebody has sat this form. Retire it instead — deleting it would leave their result pointing at a paper that no longer exists.
texts.IMS:ExamForm:CodeTaken: Another form of this exam already uses that code. A code has to identify one paper on a result sheet.
texts.IMS:ExamForm:DuplicateQuestions: The same question appears twice on this form. It would be scored twice and read twice.
texts.IMS:ExamForm:NoLongerUsable: None of this paper's questions can still be drawn — they have been deactivated, or the exam has been refiled under a different domain or level. Nobody can sit it as it stands.
texts.IMS:ExamForm:NoQuestions: A form cannot be published with no questions on it.
texts.IMS:ExamForm:NotEditable: A published form cannot be changed. Two candidates who sat it must have answered the same paper — retire it and build another.
texts.IMS:ExamForm:QuestionNotAvailable: One of those questions is not one this exam can draw. It belongs to another domain or level.
texts.IMS:ExamLink:AttemptsExhausted: You have used all the attempts allowed. Contact whoever sent you the link.
texts.IMS:Attempt:AlreadyStarting: Your sitting has already started. Try again to carry on from where you are.
texts.IMS:ExamLink:Expired: This link has expired. Contact whoever sent it to you to ask for a new one.
texts.IMS:ExamLink:ExpiryInPast: A link cannot be extended to a time that has passed.
texts.IMS:ExamLink:ExpiryMovedBack: A deadline cannot be moved backwards. To close an exam early, revoke the link — that tells whoever holds it.
texts.IMS:Question:DuplicateText: This exam already has a question that reads the same. Check it, or save this one anyway if you mean to.
texts.IMS:Take:SessionExpired: Your exam session has ended. Open the exam link you were sent again to carry on.
texts.IMS:Take:SessionMismatch: This session belongs to a different sitting. Open the exam link you were sent again.
texts.IMS:Take:NotStarted: The exam has not started, so there is nothing for a file to belong to.
texts.IMS:Media:NameInvalid: That file name is not valid.
texts.IMS:ExamLink:Revoked: This link was revoked. Contact whoever sent it to you.
texts.IMS:File:TooLarge: The file is larger than the {MaxMegabytes} MB limit.
texts.IMS:File:TypeNotAllowed: Files of type {Extension} are not supported.
texts.IMS:Import:NeedsNameAndEmail: This line needs at least a name and an email address.
texts.IMS:Import:NotAnEmail: Nothing on this line looks like an email address.
texts.IMS:Import:RepeatedInThisList: This email address appears earlier in the list.
texts.IMS:ItemAnalysis:NegativeDiscrimination: The strongest candidates got this wrong more often than the weakest. Nearly always a wrong answer key.
texts.IMS:ItemAnalysis:TooEasy: Almost everybody gets this right, so it separates nobody from anybody.
texts.IMS:ItemAnalysis:TooHard: Almost nobody gets this right. Either it is out of scope or the wording is doing the work.
texts.IMS:ItemAnalysis:WeakDiscrimination: Strong and weak candidates do about equally well on this, so it adds little to the score.
texts.IMS:Question:AllOptionsCorrect: Every option is correct, so the question measures nothing.
texts.IMS:Question:AllWeightsPositive: No option is priced below zero, so selecting every option scores at least as well as choosing carefully.
texts.IMS:Question:BelongsNowhere: A question must belong to an exam or to a domain in the shared bank.
texts.IMS:Question:BlankHasNoAnswer: A blank has no accepted answer.
texts.IMS:Question:CodeWithoutExpectedOutputIs: No expected output, so every submission will need marking by hand.
texts.IMS:Question:DuplicateOptionId: Duplicate option id — the saved answer becomes ambiguous once options are shuffled.
texts.IMS:Question:HotspotNeedsImage: A click-the-image question needs an image.
texts.IMS:Question:Matching:IncompletePair: A pair has one side empty, so nothing can be matched to it.
texts.IMS:Question:NeedsMarks: This question carries no marks, so skipping it costs the candidate nothing. Give it more than zero.
texts.IMS:Question:NeedsOneBlank: Fill in the blanks needs at least one blank.
texts.IMS:Question:NeedsTwoItems: Ordering needs at least two items.
texts.IMS:Question:NeedsTwoOptions: The question needs at least two options.
texts.IMS:Question:NeedsTwoPairs: Matching needs at least two pairs.
texts.IMS:Question:NegativeTolerance: The tolerance is negative, so the exactly correct answer would be marked wrong.
texts.IMS:Question:NoCorrectOption: No correct option is marked, so everyone would score zero.
texts.IMS:Question:NoCorrectRegion: No correct region is marked on the image.
texts.IMS:Question:OrderingPositionsNotSequent: Ordering positions are not a complete sequence, so partial credit is computed against a sequence that does not exist.
texts.IMS:Question:PayloadUnreadable: The question data could not be read.
texts.IMS:Question:RubricCriterionNeedsScore: Every rubric criterion needs a score above zero.
texts.IMS:Question:Scale:NoLabels: Neither end is labelled, so a taker has to guess which end is which.
texts.IMS:Question:Scale:TooManyPoints: That is more than twenty points, which is usually a typo.
texts.IMS:Question:ScaleCarriesNoMarks: A scale question carries no marks: it has no right answer, so the marks are taken from everybody and earned by nobody. Set it to zero.
texts.IMS:Question:ScaleRangeInvalid: The scale range is not valid.
texts.IMS:Question:SectionNotInExam: That part belongs to a different exam. A question can only be filed into a section of the exam that owns it.
texts.IMS:Question:SelectingEverythingScoresFu: Selecting every option would score full marks. Price the wrong options low enough that the total falls short of the whole question.
texts.IMS:Question:SingleChoiceHasManyCorrect: A single-choice question has more than one correct option, so nobody can pass it.
texts.IMS:Question:UnknownTypeWillBeManual: This build does not know that type, so it will be marked by hand.
texts.IMS:Question:WeightConflictsWithCorrectF: The option marked correct must be weighted exactly 1, and only an option weighted 1 may be marked correct.
texts.IMS:Question:WeightMissing: Weighted scoring is on, but an option has no weight.
texts.IMS:Question:WeightOutOfRange: A weight is outside the allowed range of −1 to 1.
texts.IMS:Question:WeightsDoNotSumToOne: The credited options must add up to the whole question: less and nobody can score full marks, more and a partial answer does.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:AmbiguousType: “Multiple choice” could mean one answer or several. Write “single choice” or “multiple answers”.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:AnswerIsNotOneOfTheOp: The correct answer does not match any option on this row.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:FileTooLarge: That file is larger than {MaxMegabytes} MB. A question bank is text, so this is usually the wrong file.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:MarksNotANumber: The marks must be a number.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:MarksOutOfRange: The marks must be more than zero and no more than 1000.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:NoQuestionColumn: No column in this file is headed Question, so there is nothing to read. Download the example to see the headings.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:NoQuestionText: This row has no question written in it.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:NoRows: This file has headings but no questions under them.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:NoTypeColumn: No column in this file is headed Type, and the kind of question cannot be guessed. Download the example to see the headings.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:RepeatedOption: Two of the options on this row are the same.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:TooManyRows: This file has more than {Max} rows. Split it and import the parts.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:UnknownDifficulty: Write easy, medium or hard here.
texts.IMS:QuestionImport:UnknownType: This is not a question type this can read.
texts.IMS:Review:ScoreAboveMaximum: The mark awarded ({Awarded}) is above the question's maximum ({Maximum}).
texts.IMS:User:PasswordRequired: A new account needs a password.
texts.Link:Extend:Body: {0}'s link has passed its deadline, or is about to. Choose a new one.
texts.Link:Extend:ForwardOnly: Forward only. To close an exam early, revoke the link.
texts.Link:Reissued:Body: This is {0}'s link. The one they had before has stopped working. Copy it now — a link is stored hashed and cannot be read back.
texts.Link:Reissued:EmailFailed: Could not email {0}. Copy the link and pass it on another way.
texts.Link:Reissued:Title: A new link
texts.Media:Choose: Choose a file, or drop one here
texts.Media:Hint: Images, audio and video. Up to 20 MB.
texts.Monitor:Delete:Body: For a test run or a sitting that should never have started. Everything it recorded is removed and nothing is marked.
texts.Monitor:Delete:Title: Discard this attempt?
texts.Monitor:End:Body: Everything answered so far counts in full and will be marked. The candidate cannot continue afterwards.
texts.Monitor:End:Reason:Placeholder: Browser froze; candidate asked to stop.
texts.Monitor:End:Title: End this sitting?
texts.Monitor:IncludeExpired:Hint: These close by themselves within a minute. Shown only if you need to see one that has not.
texts.Monitor:Lede: Who is sitting an exam right now. Useful when somebody is in the room and their browser has stopped responding.
texts.Monitor:NoneRunningNote: This fills while an exam is being taken, and empties as people submit.
texts.Monitor:Title: In progress
texts.Question:Blanks:Answers:Hint: Separate alternatives with a vertical bar. Every spelling you list counts as right.
texts.Question:Blanks:CaseSensitive:Hint: Off by default. Marking an answer wrong for a lower-case letter usually tests typing, not knowledge.
texts.Question:Blanks:Lede: Write the sentence in the question above, leaving a gap where each blank goes. List what each gap accepts here.
texts.Question:Blanks:PartialCredit:Hint: Award a share for the blanks filled correctly instead of all or nothing.
texts.Question:Category:Hint: Filing this makes it findable, and lets every exam in the domain draw it.
texts.Question:Category:Required: A bank question needs a domain. Without one nothing can draw it.
texts.Question:ChooseType: What kind of question is this?
texts.Question:Code:Expected:Hint: Compared against what the program prints, line by line, ignoring trailing spaces. Leave it empty and a person marks the answer.
texts.Question:Code:Language:Hint: Sets the editor the candidate gets. Leave it open when the language is not what is being tested.
texts.Question:Code:Starter:Hint: A signature, a comment, a partly written function. Leave it empty for a blank page.
texts.Question:Code:WillBeAutoGraded: Marked automatically against the expected output.
texts.Question:Code:WillBeManual: No expected output, so a person will read every answer.
texts.Question:Delete:BankNote: This question is in the shared bank, so deleting it takes it out of every exam at this level. Attempts already sat keep their marks.
texts.Question:Delete:Note: Attempts already sat keep their marks for it — the question is hidden, not erased.
texts.Question:Delete:Title: Delete this question?
texts.Question:Difficulty:Hint: Blueprints draw by difficulty, so a bank that is all one level cannot produce a balanced form.
texts.Question:Explanation:Hint: Shown only in practice mode, after submitting. A learner who sees only a score has not learned anything.
texts.Question:Health:TooEasy:Hint: A question nearly everyone answers correctly separates nobody. It may still belong at the start of a paper.
texts.Question:Health:TooHard:Hint: A question almost nobody answers correctly is usually a question whose answer key is wrong. It reads as a hard question until somebody looks.
texts.Question:Hotspot:ChooseImage: Choose the picture the question is about — a chart, a diagram, a screenshot.
texts.Question:Hotspot:Lede: Drag across the picture to mark each area that counts as right.
texts.Question:Level:Hint: Leave this open and the question suits every level in the domain.
texts.Question:List:Lede: Everything this exam can draw: the questions written into it, and the bank questions its domain and level make available.
texts.Question:Matching:Lede: Write each pair on one row. Candidates see the two columns shuffled and match them up.
texts.Question:Matching:PartialCredit:Hint: Award a share for the pairs matched correctly instead of all or nothing.
texts.Question:Media:Hint: Shown with the question. A chart, a recording, a passage read aloud — anything the question is about rather than anything decorating it.
texts.Question:NoMatchesNote: Try a different type, difficulty, or wording.
texts.Question:NoneYetNote: An exam needs at least one question before it can be published.
texts.Question:Ordering:Lede: Write the steps in the right order. Candidates see them shuffled and put them back.
texts.Question:Ordering:PartialCredit:Hint: Award a share for the steps placed correctly instead of all or nothing.
texts.Question:PartialCredit:Hint: Award a share of the marks for the correct picks. Either way a single wrong pick loses the whole mark for the question, otherwise ticking every box would score full marks.
texts.Question:RawPayload:Hint: This build ships no editor for this type, so its data is edited directly. It will still save and will be marked by hand.
texts.Question:Rubric:Guidance:Hint: What earns full marks, and what does not. Never shown to the candidate.
texts.Question:Rubric:Lede: A person marks this question. A rubric tells them what to look for, and makes two reviewers agree.
texts.Question:Rubric:Mismatch: The rubric totals {0}, which does not add up to the question's {1} marks.
texts.Question:Rubric:None: No rubric. Reviewers will award marks from the question total with nothing to go on.
texts.Question:Scale:Lede: A rating, not a right answer. Someone reads these afterwards.
texts.Question:Section:Hint: Which part of the paper this question belongs to. A sectioned exam is drawn part by part, so a question left unfiled is one no part of the paper can serve.
texts.Question:Timer:Hint: Leave empty to use the exam's own limit.
texts.Question:Tolerance:Hint: How far from the correct value still counts. Leave at zero to demand an exact match.
texts.Question:Topic:Hint: What this question is about. It is what turns a score into a breakdown.
texts.Question:Unit:Hint: Shown beside the field. Not part of the comparison.
texts.Question:Weighted:Hint: For questions where several answers are defensible and one is best. An option can be worth full marks, a share of them, nothing, or less than nothing.
texts.QuestionImport:AlreadyThere: already in this bank, left as they are
texts.QuestionImport:ChooseFile:Hint: In Excel choose File, Save as, and pick CSV UTF-8. Arabic needs the UTF-8 one.
texts.QuestionImport:Column:Question: Question
texts.QuestionImport:Columns:Hint: Columns: Type, Question, Option 1 to Option 4, Correct answer, Marks, Difficulty, Explanation. Anything else in the sheet is ignored.
texts.QuestionImport:Correct:Hint: The correct answer can be the option's number (2), several numbers (1,3), or the answer written out.
texts.QuestionImport:Lede: One question per row. Save your spreadsheet as CSV and choose it here — nothing is written until you have seen what it read.
texts.QuestionImport:NothingToAdd: Nothing in this file can be added yet. Fix the rows above and choose the file again.
texts.QuestionImport:Sample:1:Explanation: Cairo has been the capital since 1168.

texts.QuestionImport:Sample:2:Question: Which of these cities are in Egypt?
texts.QuestionImport:Sample:3:Question: The Nile is the longest river in Africa.
texts.QuestionImport:Sample:4:Explanation: Every spelling listed counts as right.

texts.QuestionImport:Template:Hint: Fill in the example and send it back. The headings are the ones this reads.
texts.QuestionImport:Title: Import a spreadsheet of questions
texts.QuestionImport:Types:Hint: Write one of: single choice, multiple answers, true or false, short answer.
texts.Results:Detail:NoTopics: The questions on this paper carry no topic, so there is nothing to break the score down by. Set topics in the catalogue and future results will show one.
texts.Results:Detail:Question: Question
texts.Results:ItemAnalysis:Lede: How each question has behaved across every sitting. A question everybody gets right measures nothing; one the strongest candidates get wrong is usually mis-keyed.
texts.Results:ItemAnalysis:NotEnough: Not enough sittings yet to say anything about these questions.
texts.Results:ItemAnalysis:PickExam: Choose an exam to see how its questions have behaved.
texts.Results:Lede: Every sitting, what it scored, and how long it took.
texts.Results:NoneYetNote: Results appear as soon as somebody submits. Send an exam and this fills itself.
texts.Review:AllMarked: Every answer on this attempt has been marked.
texts.Review:Attempt:Lede: Award marks and write what the person should know. Your comment reaches them.
texts.Review:Attempt:Title: Marking
texts.Review:Comment:Hint: This is shown to them with their result, so it is feedback rather than a note to yourself.
texts.Review:Finished:Hint: To revisit a mark, or put one right.
texts.Review:Observation:DevToolsOpened: Developer tools appeared to open {0} time(s). Recorded only — this is not blocked, and cannot reliably be.
texts.Review:Observation:ImplausibleSpeed: {0} answer(s) submitted faster than the text length suggests is possible.
texts.Review:Observation:NoCorrections: {0} long answer(s) typed with no corrections.
texts.Review:Observation:WindowBlur: Left the exam window {0} time(s), for {1} seconds in total.
texts.Review:Observations:Lede: What happened during the attempt, not what it means. Weigh it against everything else you know.
texts.Review:Queue:EmptyNote: Every submitted attempt has been marked.
texts.Review:Queue:Lede: Attempts waiting on a person, oldest first.
texts.Review:Signals:Hint: Things noticed during the attempt. For you to weigh, not a verdict.
texts.Role:Default: Give it to every new account
texts.Role:Default:Hint: New accounts start with this role without anybody assigning it.
texts.Role:Delete:Body: The role "{0}" will be deleted. Anybody holding it loses what it granted.
texts.Role:Lede: What each role may do. Add one that fits your organisation, and decide its permissions.
texts.Role:Name: Name
texts.Role:Name:Hint: A name whoever assigns roles will recognise — "Invigilator", "Senior coordinator".
texts.Role:Permissions:Lede: What somebody holding this role may do. Ticking a permission ticks the one it sits under.
texts.Role:Title: Roles
texts.ScreenNotBuiltYet: This screen is still being built. The services behind it are ready and it will be connected shortly.
texts.Section:Enforced:Body: What does work: the paper is ordered section by section, "Questions drawn" is honoured when a paper is drawn per candidate, the candidate is shown the name of the part they are in and its instructions when it begins, and the result breaks down by section.
texts.Section:Instructions:Hint: Shown to the candidate on the first question of this part, before they answer it.
texts.Section:Lede: Grammar, listening, reading, writing. A section can have its own clock and its own floor, so a result says which part somebody was weak in rather than giving one number for four different things.
texts.Section:Minimum:Hint: A floor for this section alone.
texts.Section:Name: Name
texts.Section:NoneYet: No sections. The whole exam is one part, which is right for a short quiz and wrong for anything with reading and listening in it.
texts.Section:NotEnforced:Body: The section clock, the minimum percentage and "must be passed" are stored and read by nothing. Every candidate gets the exam’s single clock, and no section can fail an exam on its own. Do not rely on them yet.
texts.Section:NotEnforced:Field: Saved, but nothing enforces this yet.
texts.Section:NotEnforced:Title: Three of these are saved but not yet enforced
texts.Section:Qualifying:Hint: Fail this section and the whole exam is failed, however well the rest went. This is how a safety module or a listening component behaves.
texts.Section:TimeLimit:Hint: Its own clock, separate from the exam's. Leave empty to share the exam's.
texts.Section:Title: Sections
texts.Section:Topic:Hint: Ties the section to a topic, so it draws the right questions and the result breaks down by it.
texts.Settings:Brand:Lede: What candidates see. Somebody opening a link to sit your exam has no relationship with us and no reason to trust a name they have never heard of.
texts.Settings:BrandColor:Hint: One colour, used for buttons and highlights. The rest of the palette stays as it is so text remains readable.
texts.Settings:DefaultLanguage:Hint: What people here get before they choose one. Anyone can still switch.
texts.Settings:Integrity:Hint: Pasting, leaving the tab, and how long each answer took. Useful for a certificate, unnecessary for practice, and in some places not something to record without telling people.
texts.Settings:Lede: How this platform behaves for your organisation. Nothing here affects anyone else using it.
texts.Settings:Logo:Hint: An image. It replaces our mark rather than sitting beside it — two logos in one corner reads as a partnership nobody agreed to.
texts.Settings:OrganizationName:Hint: Shown in the header, on the screen a candidate opens their link on, and in the invitation email.
texts.Settings:PassMark:Hint: Applied to a new exam unless its author changes it. Existing exams keep what they were set to.
texts.Settings:ReadOnly: You can see these settings but not change them. Ask an administrator.
texts.Settings:ShowResult: Show the result to the candidate
texts.Settings:ShowResult:Hint: As soon as marking finishes. Turn it off where a result has to be released by a person — a certificate that arrives before the coordinator has seen it is hard to take back.
texts.Settings:TimeZone:Hint: Every exam clock and scheduled window is read in this zone. Getting it wrong opens exams at the wrong hour.
texts.Stimulus:Field:Hint: Attach this question to a passage and the candidate sees the passage beside it.
texts.Stimulus:Instructions:Placeholder: Read the passage and answer questions 1–6.
texts.Stimulus:Lede: One passage, several questions. The candidate sees it once beside each of its questions rather than repeated in every prompt.
texts.Stimulus:Media:Hint: For a listening or viewing task. A passage can have text, a file, or both.
texts.Stimulus:NeedsContent: A passage needs either text or a file. An empty one would be shown to the candidate as a blank box.
texts.Stimulus:NoQuestions: Nothing is attached to this yet, so no candidate will ever see it. Open a question and set its passage.
texts.Stimulus:NoneYet: No passages yet. Add one for a reading text or a listening clip that several questions hang off.
texts.Stimulus:Section:Note: A passage belongs to no part of the exam by itself. File each of its questions into the same section and they are drawn together, as one whole passage.
texts.Stimulus:Text:Hint: Plain text. Line breaks are kept.
texts.Stimulus:Text:Placeholder: Paste or type the reading passage here.
texts.Stimulus:Title: Passages, clips and videos
texts.Structure:Lede: How this exam is laid out: its parts, and the passages inside it.
texts.Structure:Title: Layout
texts.Take:Code:WriteCode: Write your code in the box below.
texts.Take:Code:WriteOutput: Write what the program prints, not the program itself. Your answer is compared with the expected output as text.
texts.Take:Code:StartedFromTemplate: We have started you off with the template the author wrote. Change it as you like.
texts.Take:Rubric:Heading: Your answer is marked on
texts.Take:Audio:Hint: Press to start recording. You can listen back and redo it before moving on.
texts.Take:Audio:NoPermission: The microphone could not be used. Allow the browser to use it, then try again.
texts.Take:Audio:Stored: We have your recording. You can play it back, or record again.
texts.Take:Audio:Unsupported: This browser cannot record. Try another browser, or tell the invigilator.
texts.Take:Blocked:Copy: Copying the exam text is not available.
texts.Take:Blocked:Paste: Pasting is not available during the exam. Please type your answer here.
texts.Take:CannotOpen:Help: Contact whoever sent you this link. They can send a new one.
texts.Take:Hotspot:Instruction: Point to the place on the image. Or focus the image and use the arrow keys.
texts.Take:Hotspot:NoImage: This question has no image. Tell the invigilator.
texts.Take:Hotspot:Placed: You chose {0}% across and {1}% down. Point again to change it.
texts.Take:Result:Pending: Your answers are with a marker
texts.Take:Result:Pending:Body: Some questions on this exam are marked by a person. Your result will be available once that is done.
texts.Take:Result:Withheld:Body: This organisation releases results itself once they are approved. Yours will come from them.
texts.Take:ResumeNotice: You already started this exam. Continuing picks up where you left off, and the clock has been running since.
texts.Take:Rule:Autosave: Every answer is saved as you go. You can leave a question and come back.
texts.Take:Rule:OneAttempt: Once you finish, the exam is submitted and cannot be reopened.
texts.Take:Rule:Timer: The timer runs on our server, so closing the page or losing connection does not stop it.
texts.Take:SessionEnded: Your session has ended. Open your exam link again to carry on.
texts.Take:CouldNotReachUs: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again; if it keeps happening, write to the centre that invited you.
texts.Settings:SupportEmail:Hint: Shown to a candidate before an exam and during it. Somebody whose connection drops, or whose recording will not start, has nowhere to write but to us — and they have no relationship with us: you invited them, and you hold their result. Leave it empty and nothing is shown.
texts.Take:Support:Before: If something goes wrong, write to:
texts.Take:Support:During: Trouble with this exam? Write to:
texts.Take:Submit:Body: Once submitted the exam cannot be reopened.
texts.Take:Submit:Title: Finish and submit?
texts.Take:Upload:Hint: PDF, Word, text or an image, up to 10 MB.
texts.Tenant:Admin:Hint: Created with the organisation, and signs in as "admin". Without one, nobody can get in.
texts.Tenant:Delete:Body: Everything "{0}" owns will go: its exams, its questions, its people, and every result they ever sat. This cannot be undone.
texts.Tenant:Lede: The companies and academies on this deployment. None of them can see another.
texts.Tenant:Name: Name
texts.Tenant:Name:Hint: Typed at sign-in, so keep it short and without spaces — "academy-riyadh".
texts.Tenant:Title: Organisations
texts.Failure:SignedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to carry on.
texts.Failure:NoNetwork: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
texts.User:DeleteWarning: "{0}" will be removed and will no longer be able to sign in. Anything they authored stays where it is.
texts.User:Lede: Staff accounts. Candidates never appear here — their link is their whole credential, and asking somebody sitting one exam to manage a password would be work for nothing.
texts.User:Password:Keep: Leave blank to keep the current one.
texts.User:Roles:Empty: This account has no role, so it will sign in and see an empty application. Its owner will read that as a broken login.
texts.Candidate:Phone:Hint: Optional. A second way to reach somebody.
texts.Candidate:Category:Hint: The subject area — not the class. Classes are managed on the Groups screen.
texts.Review:AttachmentUnreadable: This attachment could not be opened. Do not mark work you have not seen — tell an administrator.
texts.Take:Map:NoJumping: This exam does not allow going back, so the map shows what is left but does not move you.
texts.Take:Submit:GoToFirst: Go to the first one with no answer
texts.IMS:Group:EmptyingNotConfirmed: The class was not saved: an empty list arrived without confirming that emptying it was meant. Most often the current roll failed to load — reopen it.
texts.Group:Empty:Title: Empty this class of everybody?
texts.Group:Empty:Body: Nobody will be left in it. If you expected names here, the roll most likely failed to load — close it and open it again.
texts.IMS:Attempt:ClosedForUploads: This sitting is over, so files can no longer be uploaded. A file that was already on its way when the time ran out is still accepted and kept.
texts.Take:Scoring:exact: Choose every correct answer. The mark is given only if you choose them all and choose nothing wrong.
texts.Take:Scoring:partial: Choose every correct answer. You earn a share of the mark for what you get right, but a single wrong choice loses the whole mark for this question.
texts.Take:Scoring:weighted: Choose every correct answer. Each option carries its own weight and some subtract — the question can never score below zero.
texts.Take:Scoring:all: The question scores only if the whole answer is right; no partial mark is given.
texts.Exam:Group:Schedule:Lede: Leave this off and the exam is open from the moment it is published. Turn it on and it opens and closes at the hours you set here.
texts.Exam:Scheduled:Hint: Outside the window a candidate with a valid link is told the exam is not available. Their link is not spent.
texts.Exam:Schedule:Zone: These hours are read in the organisation's time zone: {0}.
texts.Exam:Schedule:ZoneUnset: These hours are read in the organisation's time zone, which is set on the settings screen. Until it is set, the server's own clock is used.
texts.Review:MarkedOn: Marked on {0}. Changing anything below replaces that mark.
texts.Review:Queue:Finished:Lede: Sittings a person has marked, newest first. Open one to correct a mark.
texts.Review:Queue:Finished:EmptyNote: Once somebody marks a sitting it appears here, so the mark can be put right afterwards.
texts.Question:Section:BankNote: A bank question is filed into no one part: it serves every exam at its level and belongs to no single paper. A section that names what it measures draws from the bank on that — so set the question's topic, and it will reach the right part.
